sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the major maintenance 
procedures P2, which must be performed every three years or when occur hummed noise, scratch, rumble noises or excessive 
temperature increases during the operation or after 24000 operating hours as 
indicated by Y3/H24000 in the title block.

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber Ibrahem, tested by eng. Alsayed Ibrahim El Ashmony, 
accepted by general director eng. Abdel Ghaffar Osman, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director and MPIS Coordinator.
Technical specifications
Manufacturer: Allweiler - germany

Q : 750 
L/min 
P : 10 bar 
N : 1450 I/min
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل وصيانة مؤهلة 
 يحمل الموظفون فئة معرف السلامة المناسبة،

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety Helmet.
The pump must be out of operation
Isolated the electrical power supply from the motor
Isolated the pump by closed of the inlet and outlet oil valve

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Dismount the electric 
motor (by maintenance electric stuff)

Drain the remaining oil in 
the pump, suction and delivery pipes

Draw off coupling half on 
the pump side by means of a detaching device

Remove key (41) from the 
shaft end of the driving screw

Slacken socket - head cap 
screws (51) and dismount slid - in pump towards the driving side. (Use forcing 
screws)

Slacken socket - head cap 
screws (54), dismount stuffing box casing (76). (Use forcing screws)
Dismount circlip (35)

Slacken socket - head cap 
screws (55) dismount screw set with pump cover on the driving side (3) from the 
casing insert (2) and remove working screws with compensating bushes (8) from 
the driving screw

Dismount driving screw 
with grooved ball bearing (34) from pump cover on the driving side (3)
